name: TOB WhatsApp Message
description: One row per WhatsApp message (inbound, mirrored from a Chatwoot webhook; outbound, recorded when the admin/a campaign sends one) mirrored under a TOB WhatsApp Conversation. v1 sends/receives TEXT only (contract SS3.6); other message_type values are modeled so an inbound image/document from a real user renders as a labeled placeholder instead of being dropped. Never stores a Chatwoot credential, only correlation IDs.

fields.label: Chatwoot Message ID
fields.description: Used for idempotency when mirroring an inbound Chatwoot webhook delivery, which is not guaranteed exactly-once.

fields.label: Message Type
fields.options:
TEXT
IMAGE
DOCUMENT
AUDIO
VIDEO
UNSUPPORTED

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Text content; for a non-text message_type, a caption if any. The media itself is not proxied or stored by this backend.
